collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A child with a cough refuses a bitter healing tea: drink some yourself first, or ask what would help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a cough, and (healer), the healer, has made a tea for it. The tea is dark green. It smells like a swamp. (subject) is sitting with the cup in both hands, absolutely refusing, with (subject.his/her) mouth shut tight. (friend) is sitting across from (subject.him/her).

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "I'll have a sip first," says (friend), and does. (friend.His/her) face does something remarkable. "Oh," (friend.he/she) says. "Oh, that's horrible." (subject) starts giggling. Then, still giggling, (subject.he/she) takes a sip too, and makes exactly the same face. They finish the cup between them, one awful sip each.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "What would make it easier?" asks (friend). (subject) thinks. "Honey. Lots." (friend) asks (healer), who says a little honey is fine. With honey it's merely terrible. (subject) drinks it in tiny sips, with tremendous suffering, and complains loudly the whole time. The cough is better the next day. Maybe it was the tea. Maybe not.
